title: DFN: Craftable Dried Ghast
description: A simple mod that adds a crafting recipe for the Dried Ghast using 1 Fire Charge and 2 Ghast Tears
body:
# DFN: Craftable Dried Ghast

**A simple mod that lets you craft Dried Ghast from 1 Fire Charge and 2 Ghast Tears!**
